test_item:
The KeyInstall feature shall operate on the Android 14 (AAOS) platform utilizing Qualcomm hardware, adhering to the following constraints:
(RAM usage and the oemkeys partition size stay within the stated targets)
pre: 1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
proc:
1. Read the process resource usage on the DUT
$ adb shell procrank
2. Read the size of the oemkeys partition on the DUT
$ adb shell df /mnt/vendor/oemkeys
er:
1. The adb shell procrank output shows the KeyInstall RAM usage within the stated limit
2. The adb shell df /mnt/vendor/oemkeys output shows the partition size within the stated target
design: 基礎故障注入 (Fault Injection Lite)
author: PeiPYHsu
